categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration in an industrial dispute. It references specific legislative enactments, amendments, and statutory procedures without involving government structural changes, personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister serves to establish legal authority rather than constituting a government personnel announcement.
